name: Immobilizer Eldrazi — 'each creature with toughness greater than its power can't block', judged on P/T after layer 7
notes: Memory: project_stone_giant_toughness_less_than_source_power_2026-10-18. '{2}{C}: Each creature with toughness greater than its power can't block this turn': 'with toughness greater than its power' was not in the filter vocabulary, so it became a required subtype and the fired rule reached nobody. The subject now compares each creature with itself, after layer 7. Wall of Wood (0/3) and the opponent's Horned Turtle (1/4) can't block; Grizzly Bears (2/2) and Immobilizer Eldrazi (2/1) can; Storm Crow (1/2) can, because Brute Strength makes it 4/3.
